normative_extracts.quote: Let parent be ? O.[[GetPrototypeOf]](). If parent is null, return undefined. Return ? parent.[[Get]](P, Receiver).

pipeline_phases: Own Property Check via Hidden Class
engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Property reads walk [[Prototype]] links until a match or null; V8 caches prototype-chain offsets in Inline Caches guarded by prototype Map checks.

production_failures.root_cause: Mutating an object's prototype at runtime with Object.setPrototypeOf invalidates V8 Hidden Classes and forces megamorphic slow-path lookups.
production_failures.mitigation: Assign prototypes once via class syntax or Object.create() before instances enter hot loops.

production_failures.symptom: Prototype pollution escalates to XSS or auth bypass
production_failures.root_cause: Recursive object-merge utilities copy __proto__ or constructor.prototype keys from untrusted JSON onto Object.prototype.
production_failures.mitigation: Use Object.create(null) for dictionaries and reject __proto__, constructor, and prototype keys during merges.
